holdout_card.fact_statement: Thailand's Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation confirmed that the aftershocks on 31 March were too weak to affect Thailand.
holdout_card.answer: Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation
holdout_card.source_span: While initially reported by some outlets as being due to aftershocks, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation confirmed that the aftershocks on 31 March were too weak to affect Thailand.

qa_variants.question: Which Thai agency confirmed that the 31 March aftershocks of the 2025 Myanmar earthquake were too weak to affect Thailand?
qa_variants.expected_answer: Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation
